# GSM A/C & General Contractor INC

> Professional HVAC services platform for Houston/Cypress, TX area

## Overview

Full-stack Next.js 15 application for GSM A/C & General Contractor INC, featuring:
- Public landing page with HVAC services
- Admin dashboard for appointments and email campaigns
- Automated email campaign system with daily batch sending

Website: https://www.gsmactx.com
Phone: (281) 235-4684
Location: Cypress, TX 77433

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15.3.6 (App Router)
- React 19.2.4 (with React Compiler)
- TypeScript 5+
- TailwindCSS 4.1.18
- Prisma 7.4.0 (PostgreSQL via Supabase)
- Resend (email)
- Zod 4.3.6 (validation)
- Zustand 5.0.11 (state)
- Framer Motion 12.34.0 (animations)
- React Hook Form 7.71.1

## Architecture

### Server Actions (Primary)
All CRUD operations use Server Actions, not API routes:
- Authentication: loginAction, logoutAction
- Appointments: create, update, delete, list
- Campaigns: create, edit, send, track
- Subscribers: manage, unsubscribe

### API Routes (Cron Only)
- /api/cron/keepalive - Health check (every 5 hours)
- /api/cron/send-campaigns - Daily batch sender (8 AM CST)

### Database Models
- Admin: JWT-authenticated users
- Appointment: 9 service types, 5 statuses
- Campaign: Email campaigns with stats
- Subscriber: Newsletter with unsubscribe tokens
- CampaignEmailLog: Delivery tracking

## Key Features

### Public Site
- Hero section with trust indicators
- 6 HVAC service pages
- Contact form (reCAPTCHA v3)
- Appointment booking (time slot validation)
- Google Business reviews
- SEO (JSON-LD, sitemap, meta tags)

### Admin Dashboard
- JWT authentication (24-hour tokens)
- Appointment calendar view
- Campaign management (100/day limit)
- Batch email sending
- Failed email retry
- Image upload (Vercel Blob)

## Code Conventions

### Always
- Server Components by default
- Server Actions for mutations
- Zod validation before DB
- next/image with alt text
- Mobile-first design
- Promise.all() for parallel fetches

### Never
- 'use client' without necessity
- API routes for CRUD
- useCallback/useMemo (React 19 compiler)
- Hardcoded colors
- Data fetching waterfalls

## File Structure

```
src/app/           # Routes and server actions
src/components/    # React components (67 total)
src/lib/           # Utilities, validations, data
src/hooks/         # Custom React hooks
src/store/         # Zustand state
src/types/         # TypeScript definitions
prisma/            # Database schema and migrations
docs/              # Documentation
```

## Environment Variables

Required: DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, JWT_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY,
FROM_EMAIL, NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY,
NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL

## Deployment

Vercel with cron jobs configured in vercel.json.
Build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build

## Documentation

- CLAUDE.md: AI assistant instructions
- docs/CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM.md: Email workflow
- docs/CRON_SETUP.md: Automated jobs
- docs/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md: System integration
